summary: Steep 31 m main-road kerb with houses 10-12 m away, no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 10 m (at 23 m) and 12 m (at 5 m) from the kerb, with more within 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb strip with trees and a bank behind it; no pull-off or gravel area.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a bus stop pad and moving traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked here; signs bar stopping 8-9am and 2:30-3:30pm on school days.

flags: Steep: 7.3% mean grade, 25% max in the DEM
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover over the kerb, from the south and the east.
